text: Welcome to the Declarative Web Presentation Engine showcase.
All slide transitions, speech clips, video modals, and terminal streams are orchestrated via timeline.yaml.
Watch as the engine overlays centered video modals and speech captions in real-time.
Side-panel videos allow real-time watch-along demos while slide content and live toast notifications remain visible.
Crisp vector VT100 and ANSI DOM terminal streams replay deterministically with 256-color SGR tables and live spinners.
Speech audio clips play seamlessly with clean buffer management and frame-accurate Opus playback.
Clone engine/template/ into your new deck directory and start presenting!
